summary: End-to-end frontend testing of typed maintenance parameters (Number/Text/Radio/Checkbox with photo-required and alert flags) across Equipment Master editor, Production Run Wizard capture flow, photo-required option gating, param summaries with thumbnails, and Maintenance Profile history. Also re-ran both backend regression scripts (manual_typed_params.py, manual_run_wizard.py) — both PASS. 6/6 UI phases PASS. No issues found.

test_results.backend_regression_manual_run_wizard: PASS — initiate 200, 2nd initiate+cancel 200, start blocked 409, clear w/o params 400, clear 200, start 200, stop 200, post complete 200 (out-of-range record), close blocked 409, close dup 400, close 200 (notified 4), PDF 200 application/pdf, cancel closed 409.
test_results.PHASE1_editor_persistence: PASS — Reopened Edit for ZZ PARAM Pump: eq-params-block shows 3 rows. Row0 name=Pressure type=number unit=bar min=1 max=5. Row1 name=Condition type=radio with eq-param-1-opt-label-0='OK', eq-param-1-opt-label-1='Leaking', eq-param-1-opt-photo-1=yes, eq-param-1-opt-alert-1=yes. Row2 name=Notes type=text required=False (as saved). GET /api/production/equipment confirms maintenance_parameters persisted with types+options+photo_required+alert.
test_results.PHASE2_wizard_pre_row: PASS — Initiate SKU 'Demo 500ml' → wizard opened; run-check-<eqId> row visible with 'BEFORE RUN · ZZ PARAM Pump · 3 parameters' badge and Pending state.
test_results.PHASE3_capture_dialog_typed: PASS — Tick opened param-capture-dialog with capture-pressure, capture-condition (with capture-condition-opt-ok / capture-condition-opt-leaking pill buttons), and capture-notes. capture-submit disabled with empty state; still disabled after only pressure=3 (radio required missing); enabled after selecting OK. Submit → row shows run-check-params-<eqId> with 'Pressure: 3 bar · Condition: OK · Notes: fine'. Undo restored Pending state.
test_results.PHASE4_photo_required_gating: PASS — Selecting Leaking pill showed capture-condition-photo-hint='Live photo required for this option' (amber), capture-condition-camera button appeared, and capture-submit remained disabled. Camera+snap not executed in this environment (no fake-media flags in the launched browser) — instead verified via API path per review-request instructions in Phase5.
test_results.PHASE5_photo_summary_with_thumbnail: PASS — POST /maintenance/equipment/<eqId>/param-photo (JPEG) 200 → then /maintenance/pre-production/<eqId>/clear with parameter_values {pressure:3, condition:{value:'Leaking', photo_ids:[pid]}, notes:'observed drip'} → 200 with parameters_out_of_range=['Condition = Leaking (alert)'] and 4 alert notifications created. Reloaded wizard: run-check-params-<eqId> summary renders in rose color with 'Condition: Leaking ⚠ (1 photo)' plus a rendered thumbnail (img tag with authenticated blob URL) — confirmed via inner_html containing text-rose class and 1 img descendant. Pressure and Notes lines also render.
test_results.PHASE6_profile_history: PASS — Equipment Master → 'Maintenance Profile & QR Sheet' → 'Maintenance records & audit trail' shows Complete record dated 2026-09-13 with mp-record-params-<recordId> summary rendering 'Pressure: 3 bar', 'Condition: Leaking ⚠ (1 photo)' (rose), thumbnail img rendered, and 'Notes: observed drip'. Notification bell shows 32 alerts (includes the 4 fresh ZZ PARAM alerts).

critical_code_review_comments: MaintenanceParams.js formatParam always writes '(N photo)' regardless of count — for 2+ photos it should be '(N photos)'. Minor grammar nit.

ParamInputs number-input uses parseFloat with no NaN guard: for values like '.' or '-' parseFloat returns NaN and the state stores NaN which subsequently makes outOfRange false and the display blank. Not blocking (submit gate still catches empty), but consider `Number.isFinite(...) ? parsed : null`.

ParamCaptureDialog resets its `values` state each open — this means if the parent flow ever fails to submit (network error) the operator loses the readings. Acceptable for typical flows but worth noting.

LiveCamera stops the video stream in `stop()` but the useEffect cleanup only stops streamRef.current — if the component is unmounted while `on=true` there is a small race where stream may already be null. Currently safe.
OptionRows renders an option row with `key={i}` (index) — reordering options via drag/delete could cause React to re-use inputs incorrectly. Consider stable keys (uuid) if reordering is added later.
EquipmentMaster.js line 635 (payload build) — the sanitization forces `required: p.required !== false` which correctly defaults undefined → true. Good.

Notification volume: a single Leaking submission produced 4 alert notifications (one per admin/supervisor). Verify this is intentional — alert notifs can pile up quickly across many equipment × many operators. Consider a single fan-out with distinct 'recipient_id' rather than duplicated title/body rows, if not already the model.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Testids verified end-to-end: eq-params-block; eq-param-{name,type,unit,min,max,required,remove}-<i>; eq-param-<i>-opt-{label,photo,alert}-<optIdx>; eq-param-<i>-opt-add; run-check-<eqId>; run-check-tick-<eqId>; run-check-undo-<eqId>; run-check-params-<eqId>; param-capture-dialog; capture-<key>; capture-<key>-opt-<slug(label)> (slug: lowercase [a-z0-9]+ separated by _); capture-<key>-photo-hint (amber pre-photo → emerald with count post-photo); capture-<key>-camera / capture-<key>-video / capture-<key>-snap; capture-submit / capture-cancel; mp-record-params-<recordId>. Formatting: `${name}: ${value}${unit ? ' '+unit : ''}${in_range===false ? ' ⚠' : ''}${photos.length ? ' (N photo)' : ''}`. To open equipment maintenance profile: click Equipment row's `[data-testid=eq-more-actions-<slug(name)>]` kebab → menu item 'Maintenance Profile & QR Sheet'. Edit form is behind same kebab → 'Edit Equipment Details'. Live-camera flow can't be exercised without --use-fake-device-for-media-stream, so the review request's fallback via /maintenance/equipment/<eq>/param-photo + clear payload with photo_ids works and renders thumbnail in ParamSummary.
rca of the issue: No issue — feature works as designed.
